_comment: Model registry. No weights in git. The app verifies sha256 before load; TODO checksums and sources remain fail-closed. ≥2 viable local ASR models at all times (ADR-0002); prediction models per ADR-0007.

models.note: CORRECTED 2026-07-10 (ADR-0016 research): license is CC-BY-4.0 (attribution-required), NOT Apache-2.0. nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 is a FOUR-file model (encoder-model.int8.onnx + decoder_joint-model.int8.onnx + nemo128.onnx mel preprocessor + vocab.txt, ~671MB on disk), NOT the single parakeet-v3-int8.onnx named here. TDT (token+duration transducer) decoding + ~2GB inference RAM exceeds the <=250MB ASR-resident budget (invariant 9), so it is DEMOTED (recommended:false) and DEFERRED behind the CTC-first ONNX lane until a real TDT adapter and per-platform resident evidence exist. sha256/sources stay TODO (fail-closed).

ADR-0016 CTC-first ONNX ASR lane (the ADR-0002 supply-chain hedge alongside whisper.cpp). Runs a bundled mel preprocessor + encoder ONNX graph via `ort` and decodes greedy CTC (argmax -> collapse dups -> strip blank -> vocab) — no TDT loop. Candidate model: Parakeet-CTC-110M ONNX (OpenVoiceOS/nvidia-parakeet-tdt_ctc-110m-onnx) or a Conformer/Zipformer-CTC export; ~110M params, plausibly within the <=250MB resident budget (to be MEASURED per platform before any default_for promotion, invariant 9). OPERATOR DECISIONS PENDING (ADR-0016): exact model + pinned HTTPS sources + real per-file sha256, CC-BY-4.0 attribution in app notices, and the vendored libonnxruntime binary provenance. sha256/sources stay TODO -> fail-closed (models cannot auto-select or download until real hashes land).

Measured macOS, Windows, and Linux P1 default. Apple M5 Pro proof: Q5_1 Metal 152.656 MB RSS and 78 ms p95; CPU 138.516 MB and 214 ms p95; 4/4 synthetic golden phrases at zero content-word WER. Debian 12 ARM64 CPU proof: 71.859 MB RSS, 600 ms p95, and exact synthetic golden transcript. Windows 11 ARM64 exact golden passed; four consecutive quiescent ten-sample CPU runs passed at 1121, 965, 903, and 902 ms p95 with about 73-75 MB RSS and 0% idle CPU. The first recorded 1433 ms miss is retained; its cause was not measured. Large-v3-turbo remains the quality lane until it independently meets the resident-memory budget.

Silero VAD v5.1.2 (MIT). sha256 + source VERIFIED 2026-07-10: exact 2,327,524-byte official file loaded via ort load-dynamic (ONNX Runtime 1.28.0) and proven end-to-end through SpeechGate<SileroVad> (speech clip -> segment, silence -> 0). Do NOT use the HF onnx-community quantized q4f16 variant (different bytes -> sha256 mismatch).
Gemma Terms, not Apache. Legal review before commercial bundling. Download on demand; do not bundle.
